page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.24xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance featuring 96 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 physical cores running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The server is equipped with 372 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per core. For acceleration, it bundles four NVIDIA T4 GPUs based on the Turing architecture, delivering a combined 64 GB of VRAM. It does not include local storage, relying instead on network-attached storage, and features a baseline network bandwidth of 30 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks reveal a contrast between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core CPU performance is relatively weak, as shown by a stress-ng single-core score of 1103.89 and a poor single-threaded gzip compression rate of 19.2 GB/sec. However, the 96 dedicated cores deliver strong multi-core performance, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 70574.45 and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 287.37 GB/sec. Memory performance is robust, with cached small-block read bandwidth reaching 3924.63 GB/sec, while large-block uncached read and write speeds average 147.24 GB/sec and 58.43 GB/sec respectively. Redis SET operations are highly efficient, achieving 64.27 million operations per second.

The primary tradeoff of this instance is its low single-threaded efficiency and the lack of local storage, which requires network storage configuration to avoid bottlenecks. Qualitatively, the hardware profile offers high resource density for parallelized workloads, making it a cost-efficient choice for multi-GPU tasks rather than single-threaded applications. It is best suited for workloads such as machine learning inference, parallel data processing, multi-threaded decompression, and high-throughput Redis caching.
